label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Not counted: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

reclassified.why: our browser engine could not press a visible control (its click waited and timed out), a fault on our side, not the shop's. The customer will shop here again.

findings.problem: After declining cookies, an invisible backdrop kept covering the page, so the first click on a footer category link was refused until I pressed Escape.

Product tiles on the home page and in the navigation menu have no names: only empty headings, empty paragraphs and disabled unnamed buttons, so I could not tell what products were offered or pick one.
The product list was empty when the page first appeared and only filled in on a later read, with no message that it was loading.
The size options are radios wrapped in links with no required-field message; Add To Cart only worked after I guessed to pick a size first. Many unnamed icon buttons sit beside the product details.

The View Cart and Open cart buttons opened the cart drawer, but the CHECKOUT button inside it could not be clicked in three tries, and the header Close cart toggle was covered by the announcement bar, so I could not move on to checkout.
